comment: One set of style settings for every asset in the demo.
style_suffix: cozy traditional 16-bit JRPG pixel art, warm earthy muted palette, light from the top left, crisp pixels, no anti-aliasing
style_suffix_v1_buildings: cozy traditional 16-bit JRPG pixel art, warm earthy village tones, terracotta and green-glazed tile roofs, cream plaster walls, dark timber, light from the top left, crisp pixels, no anti-aliasing
note: style_suffix_v1_buildings was used for house_anchor and the 1st prop pass; it named roofs and plaster and pulled small props toward houses, so later props use the style-only suffix.
